Site Safety Officer (Contract)
Location: Tuas Shipyard
Employment: Contract
Compensation: $3,600 - $4,200 per month
Closing date: 15/12/2026

Apply for this job

Overview
Join Delta Marine Engineering and help us grow.

What you'll do
Conduct daily site inspections and toolbox talks
Investigate incidents and prepare reports for the safety manager
Check permits to work for hot work and confined spaces

What you'll bring
Workplace Safety and Health Coordinator or equivalent
3 years in a shipyard or construction site
Contract of 12 months

Benefits
Annual leave, medical insurance, training budget

Equal opportunity employer.
